sentences.text: Learned A.P.P. waives service of notice for the respondents.
Except offence punishable under Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code ('I.P.C.'), all other offences are bailable one.

The question is whether offence under Section 328 of the I.P.C.,
in the facts and circumstances of the case, gets attracted.

Hence, the applicant is granted ad-interim anticipatory bail in terms of following order :-
 ORDER Abdul Malik S/O. Abdul Halim vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 31 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16530293/
1
(I) In the event of arrest of the applicant, in connection with Crime No. 46 of 2023 registered with Himayatnagar Police 913-ABA-464-23.odt Station, Dist.

Nanded for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv),
27(3)(e), 30(2)(a) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, he be released on executing P.R.
bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand) with surety in the like amount.
(II) The applicant shall appear before the investigating officer, as and when required for the investigating purpose.
(III) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence.

( R.G. AVACHAT, J. )
